native_inference.timing_scope: Observed call wall times and asynchronous current-CUDA-stream elapsed intervals; no added synchronize/wait; stream intervals include CPU submission gaps, not pure kernel time
native_inference.wall_scope: Native planning includes observation, DINO/depth, history, DDIM and required CPU return; native history-only calls may return before queued CUDA work completes

contact.scope: filtered normal forces; not native success

native_inference.timing_scope: Observed call wall times and asynchronous current-CUDA-stream elapsed intervals; no added synchronize/wait; stream intervals include CPU submission gaps, not pure kernel time
native_inference.wall_scope: Native planning includes observation, DINO/depth, history, DDIM and required CPU return; native history-only calls may return before queued CUDA work completes
native_inference.excludes: resource waits, environment stepping/rendering, result serialization
